claimAfterCancel(address).notice: After a schedule is cancelled, the beneficiary can still claim any vested-but-unclaimed         USDC via this function. The schedule becomes fully settled when claimed == amount.

claimable(address,address).notice: Returns the amount immediately withdrawable by the beneficiary.         Works for both active schedules (linear vesting math) and cancelled schedules         (frozen vested remainder not yet claimed).

vestedAmount(address,address).notice: Returns the cumulative vested amount for an active (non-cancelled) schedule.         Returns 0 for cancelled schedules — use claimable() for the remaining claimable amount.
